summary.text: Backend developer with 6 years in the industry, currently tech lead of a team of 5 at SoftServe. Built a payment reconciliation service in Node.js/TypeScript and PostgreSQL for a US fintech client, processing about 2 million transactions a day. Moved the team to Kubernetes (EKS), cutting deploy time from ~40 min to 8 min.
